vetSays.line: 🛡️ Finn, Maureen, Sakiko and Isidro met them at the door — 4 put down. Finn, Maureen, Sakiko, Isidro are hurt.
✨ Ability gained: Cold-Blooded (L1). You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.
🛡️ Finn, Hugo, Maureen, Sakiko and Isidro met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Finn, Hugo, Maureen, Sakiko, Isidro are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Maureen, Sanne, Farid, Dmitri and Lena met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Maureen, Sanne, Farid, Dmitri, Lena are hurt.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
🛡️ Finn, Hugo, Maureen, Isidro and Sanne met them at the door — 4 put down. Isidro didn't come back. Finn, Hugo, Maureen, Sanne are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Catalina just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sakiko just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Finn, Hugo, Maureen, Sakiko and Sanne met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Finn, Hugo, Maureen, Sakiko, Sanne are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Finn just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Finn, Hugo, Sakiko, Wei and Sanne met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Finn, Sakiko, Wei, Sanne are hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miriam just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Miriam, Devon and Benoit met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Benoit didn't come back. Devon is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mutlaq just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mutlaq just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mutlaq, Miriam and Oliver met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Miriam, Oliver are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Extended Warranty falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Extended Warranty!
